MAR.note: The document states nothing on rules or an authority on AI harms.
The only AI tool named sits in the agriculture sector, which is not general administration.

facts.fact: The Pôle Digital de l'Agriculture, de la Forêt et Observatoire de la Sécheresse announced on 6 March 2024 the signing of an agreement with Russian firm BTI Group for a proof of concept using satellites and AI for crop recognition, parcel delineation and water consumption, at the R'Mel irrigated perimeter (Loukkos) and the commune of Ait Harz Allah (El Hajeb).
